title: ISRD Writing Studio
description: A writing studio built on the Reader-First method. It takes a manuscript from first idea to a developed, reader-tested draft.
tagline: A studio for learning to write well, and for big, complicated pieces of writing.

title: Bison Island Studios
description: A subsidiary of ISRD and the home of its games. The first, a writing game, is in development.
tagline: A writing game: practise a skill on a small invented case before the real one.
